gitCommit.subject: ci: group pull request runs by PR number in the concurrency key
gitCommit.body:
ci: group pull request runs by PR number in the concurrency key

A pull_request event that arrived seconds after its PR was merged no
longer had a PR ref, landed in main's concurrency group and, with
cancel-in-progress enabled for pull requests, cancelled the queued and
running main runs, so the merge was never published. Pull request runs
are now grouped as pr-<number>, separate from branch runs.
